title: Haunted Hollywood French Quarter Ghost Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for travelers who cannot walk for 2 hours.
policies: This is a walking tour on uneven sidewalks.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This walking tour combines Hollywood horror with New Orleans' haunted history. It includes ghost stories, true crime, vampire legends, and horror filming locations. Film sites include The Originals, AHS Coven, Interview with the Vampire, and Haunted Mansion. No other tour company offers this unique hybrid experience in the French Quarter.
